kids: Eat pancakes and beignets with Santa
about: RollHouse Mentor is a bowling, arcade and escape room entertainment center on Palisades Parkway in Mentor, Ohio.
Its Breakfast with Santa is a sit down family morning held on Sunday, December 20, 2026.
The event runs from 9:30 to 11:30 AM, so families can plan on a relaxed two hour visit.
The buffet style menu lists scrambled eggs, applewood smoked bacon and breakfast potatoes with peppers and onions served on the side.
Regular and chocolate chip pancakes and fresh fruit are on the menu too.
Cinnamon sugar beignets with vanilla icing round out the plates, and orange juice and cranberry juice are the drinks.
Santa is the guest of honor and every family gets time with him during breakfast.
Kids 12 and under receive a $10 arcade card to spend on the RollHouse games.
Each family also takes home a half off bowling coupon that stays valid for one week after the breakfast.
RollHouse describes the morning as less holiday rushing and more time together, with a booking page that lists current ticket options and pricing.
The RollHouse Mentor team is also running a Christmas pop-up bar elsewhere in the building, which is a separate page on the RollHouse site.
